steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Swire, you're not authorized to make such a demand.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hey.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Even setting aside our bad blood, I don't think you're capable of taking on this responsibility.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You very well could have declared—

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: 'Chief Wei Yenwu has issued an order for the incumbent operations leader of the L.G.D. to step down and transfer all responsibilities to Superintendent Swire.'

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Can you do that? Does an order like that exist?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Tch... Don't call me that.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If you can't, then just worry about your own job. Nothing good will come of you catching this hot potato, 'Miss S.'

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: How many times do I have to tell you, that's not my last name? Listen here, Swire is just my code name. Otherwise, call me Beatrix Schwire, got it?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't give a damn what you call yourself. Nobody can tell the difference anyway.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hey...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm not in the mood to play with you. Run along and find something else to do, kid.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Ch'en... you really are a piece of shit.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And you can shove it up yours.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I'm leaving, Hoshiguma. I'd recommend you keep that crazy reptile on a leash. Don't come running to me if she ends up dead in a ditch somewhere.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Uhh, sorry, li'l Miss. Both of you sure are ill-tempered. Despite everything she said, we're still grateful for your assistance.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Never again. I want to see her bleed.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What happened to her back? It looks like a fresh wound.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: When she was carrying you to cover, a Reunion caster blasted the wall just a few meters behind her.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You should try being a little nicer to her. I'm sure it won't kill either of you to stop acting like archenemies once in a while.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...I know.
(*knock* *knock*)

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: May I come in, Madam Ch'en of Lungmen?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Come on in. She doesn't mind. Sorry to keep you waiting.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Not at all, it's fine.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Pleased to meet you, Madam Ch'en. Um... Are you available to talk with Rhodes Island right now about our mission?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: We already have a few squads assembled on the deck. We're ready to start the mission with you at any time.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Got it. I'll be right there.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I'm sorry that I overheard your earlier conversation with that blonde inspector... We understand that the L.G.D. has sustained heavy losses. However, you can trust us to do everything in our power to help.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...This isn't something we should be talking about right now.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Don't worry, Hoshiguma. You should also know that Swire is trying to stabilize the situation.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Both of you are too hot-headed.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I just gave it to her straight. Lungmen's casualties are heavy, and this is the 'truth' that they're supposed to 'know.'

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Don't say that. It's not like you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's for Lungmen's sake.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That's even less like you. You're a senior inspector, a high-ranking officer, not some politician. You've never been cut out for playing these little games.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Indeed, this is not something that a proper inspector should do, but I have no choice.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You're just too overworked and need a good vacation.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Perhaps.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Heh... I've thought about it before.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoshiguma, I could use a really, really long vacation.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Sure, after we see this through. Don't die out there.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ochre, or Spring City? How about Floria County instead? We could fit in another vacation in the time it takes to get to Ochre.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Maybe we can head back to Victoria and visit some old colleagues...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I want to take a look around your hometown.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Don't bother. It's nowhere near as interesting as Lungmen.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Haha.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's a transmission.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...It's on a secret channel.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'll see myself out then.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Appreciate it.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Speak, I'm listening.
Madam Ch'en... those Infected, Reunion... they're everywhere...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: XR02? Where are you?
Muk Wo Warehouse. I was hit by several arrows and probably won't last much longer. This is a trap...
Don't come until after they've left. I'll keep the intel on me. They won't be able to find it.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Code name XR02, hang in there. The L.G.D. will be there immediately. The intel you have with you is time-sensitive, and we must have it now.
I'm not sure, Madam Ch'en, I don't want to get in the way of your duties.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: XR02, you are not allowed to die. You must survive.
...I can't argue with you, Madam Ch'en. Please be careful.
Wait, there's something moving.
BZZZZZZZZT!!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: XR02? XR02!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoshiguma?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hm? I'm here.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Gather your squad. It's time for us to go.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, are you leaving now?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: How's the remaining operational force of Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: This is not information that we can disclose, Madam Ch'en. Our mission to assist the L.G.D. in operations, but we are not directly under your command.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't remember asking for that.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: S-sorry, I said too much.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's fine. I was just curious as to Rhodes Island's situation, and if there were any security concerns that you might need the L.G.D.'s help with.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: After being defeated by us many times, Reunion has largely given up on invading Rhodes Island. From various angles, the situation in Lungmen is far worse than what we have to deal with.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Sorry, I hope this didn't come across as rude...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: In other words, you don't need our help.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Well, for the time being, the L.G.D. does need a small favor from you.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Reunion has blocked off the main road leading to the docks. We need your help to make an opening. Time is running short for the L.G.D., so we need to do this quickly.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: We'll oblige, as part of our contract, Madam.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Excellent. Follow me!
